definitionZh: 边框右色 CSS 属性设置元素右边框的颜色 。 也可以使用短手CSS属性边框颜色或边框右侧设置.
sourceDefinition: The border-right-color CSS property sets the color of an element's right border. It can also be set with the shorthand CSS properties border-color or border-right.

sourceEvidence.sourceDefinition: The border-right-color CSS property sets the color of an element's right border. It can also be set with the shorthand CSS properties border-color or border-right.
